name: Lane Mastodon Vs. The Blubbermen
source:
The year is 2029 and the evil Blubbermen have invaded earth. Only heroic Lane Mastodon can stop them, in a setting resembling science-fiction of the 1950's.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/lane-mastodon-vs-the-blubbermen]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
2029年，邪恶的鲸脂人入侵了地球。只有英勇的莱恩乳齿象才能阻止他们，背景就像20世纪50年代的科幻小说一样。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/lane-mastodon-vs-the-blubbermen]MobyGames[/url]]
